meta.title: Software for a gaming club: AFK4.NET
meta.description: PCs, guests, till and bar of a gaming club in one program. Floor map, shifts, Telegram reports, works without internet. Tajik, Russian, English.

download.title: Download AFK4.NET
download.lead: One installer for every PC in the club, admin and gaming. The setup wizard asks what kind of PC it is.
download.buttonNote: The latest version is on the GitHub releases page. The software updates itself.
requirements: Internet for sign-in and updates. Without it, PCs keep running until the paid time ends.
download.changesLead: To turn club PCs into gaming seats, the software changes Windows settings. This is everything it does.

changes.title: AFK4.NET Agent service
changes.body: Runs as the system, talks to the club server, opens and closes the PC by session and updates the software with signed packages.

changes.title: Kiosk on gaming PCs
changes.body: A player account with automatic sign-in is created and the club screen replaces Explorer. Task Manager, Run, the registry editor and the drives, USB storage and websites the club picks are blocked per the club settings.

changes.title: Firewall rules
changes.body: Open only to the club’s local network: TCP 47615 (desk commands without internet) and TCP 80 on the admin PC (game cache).

changes.title: hosts file
changes.body: While the game cache is on, a block between the “AFK4 game cache” markers is added to the hosts file to route Steam and Epic downloads to the cache. Other lines are left untouched.

changes.title: Wake over the network
changes.body: Windows Fast Startup is turned off and the network card may wake the PC with a magic packet, so the club can turn PCs on before opening.

changes.title: Idle and scheduled shutdown
changes.body: If the club enables it, free PCs turn themselves off.

download.dataTitle: What data goes to the server
download.dataBody: Only to the AFK4.NET server the club uses: PC state, sessions and payments, a hardware description and its readings (temperatures, disks) and the list of installed programs. Details in the privacy policy.
uninstallSteps: Open Settings → Apps and uninstall AFK4.NET. If AFK4.NET Agent, AFK4.NET Player Shell, the AFK4.NET Panel or AFK4.NET Setup Payload are still listed, uninstall them too.

Uninstalling AFK4.NET Agent removes the kiosk (the player account is deleted and Windows sign-in goes back to how it was), the firewall rules, the “AFK4 game cache” block in hosts and the Windows restrictions, and turns Fast Startup back on if the software turned it off.
download.uninstallLeftovers: What stays: the network card’s permission to wake the PC over the network (it opens nothing) and the C:\ProgramData\AFK4 folder with logs and the PC key, so a reinstall does not need a new enrollment. If the PC leaves the club, delete that folder.

signing.title: Code signing policy
signing.lead: How AFK4.NET software is signed and who is responsible.
signing.attribution: Free code signing provided by SignPath.io, certificate by SignPath Foundation.
signing.whatBody: The AFK4.NET installer and the MSI packages of its parts (AFK4.NET Agent service, player screen, Panel, setup wizard), built by GitHub Actions from the open repository. We do not sign anyone else’s software.

roles.title: Committers and reviewers
roles.body: Repository members with write access. Outside contributions are reviewed by a member before merging.

roles.title: Approvers
roles.body: The project owner, who approves every release for signing by hand.

process: Every change passes required CI checks; nothing merges into main without a green run.
GitHub Actions builds the packages from this repository’s source code.
The project owner approves each signing request by hand in SignPath.
All members use multi-factor authentication on GitHub and SignPath.
signing.privacyBody: The software sends data only to the AFK4.NET server the club uses, and only to run the club. The privacy policy lists exactly what.

sections.title: Who is responsible
sections.body: The AFK4.NET platform is run by Mubinjon Mukhamedov (Tajikistan). Questions about data: hello@afk4.net.

sections.title: What data
sections.body: Club staff: name, phone number, role. Guests with an account: phone number, name, optional birth date, balance and visits. The club’s sessions, payments, cash desk and stock. From club PCs: computer name, address on the club network, a hardware description and its readings (temperatures, disks, free space), the list of installed programs and protection events.

sections.title: Why
sections.body: Only to run the club: open PCs for paid time, keep the books, show the owner reports and warn about failing PCs. Data is not sold and not shared for advertising.

sections.title: Where it is kept
sections.body: On AFK4.NET servers. Database backups are encrypted at rest in Cloudflare R2 and kept for 30 days. SMS goes through a local operator; Telegram messages go only to people who connected reports themselves.

sections.title: This website
sections.body: afk4.net sets no cookies and loads no analytics or third-party fonts.

sections.title: Contact form
sections.body: If you write through the form on the home page, your name, club name, phone and message go to the project owner in Telegram, and only to them. We use them to reply and do not pass them on. To have a message deleted, email hello@afk4.net.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: A guest or staff member can ask the club or us to show, correct or delete their data. A club can ask for its organization’s data to be deleted.

hero.title: Software for a gaming club
hero.lead: PCs, guests, till and bar in one place. Your admin sees the whole hall, a guest sits down at a PC with a phone number, and you get the shift results in Telegram.
hero.nameLine: It is called AFK4.NET. Made in Tajikistan, in Tajik, Russian and English.
hero.imageAlt: AFK4.NET Panel: a floor map with PCs, guests’ remaining time and a card of the selected PC

map.title: The whole hall on one map
map.text: Who is playing, how much time is left, which PC is free or not answering. Lock, unlock, wake, message the guest on their screen: right from the map.
map.hint: Press a PC: this is how commands look in the Panel.

till.title: Till and bar
till.text: Top-ups, tea and snacks, shifts, receipts. Money goes into a log that cannot be erased: every correction is visible.

guest.title: Guest screen
guest.text: Instead of the Windows desktop, the guest sees the club screen: sign in by phone number or QR, time left, games, bar and a “call the admin” button.
guest.imageAlt: A free PC screen: seat number, a club news item and a system bar with language, sound and network

app.title: Player app
app.text: Booking, top-up, bar orders and friends in your phone.
app.scan: Sign in at a PC: scan QR

telegram.title: Results in Telegram
telegram.text: Shift closed, till does not match, a PC is overheating. The message arrives at once, not when you next visit the club.

offline.title: No internet: the club keeps working
offline.text: Press the button. PCs keep counting time, the admin takes cash, and when the link returns everything goes to the server.
offline.off: No internet. The club keeps working.

cache.title: Games download once
cache.text: A game downloads from the internet once; the other PCs get it over the club network.
cache.pcs: The other PCs take it from the club network

langs.title: Three languages
